content.text: The Cleveland Guardians battle Shohei Ohtani and the Los Angeles Dodgers today. Find out how to watch this MLB game for free. (AP Photo/Mark J. Terrill)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Robert Fenbers, cleveland.comLOS ANGELES – Rookie Chase DeLauter and the Cleveland Guardians face two-time defending NL MVP Shohei Ohtani and the back-to-back World Series Champion Los Angeles Dodgers today – Monday, March 30 – at Dodger Stadium. This MLB game is available on multiple streaming services for free.How do I watch Guardians baseball for free today?This game will broadcast live on CleGuardians.TV and SportsNet LA at 10:10 p.m. Eastern (7:10 p.m. Pacific). There are two ways to catch this Guardians game free. Fans who have parted ways with their local cable provider can watch at no cost by utilizing a free trial from DIRECTV, which also offers $35 off your first month. FuboTV has a free trial and $25 off your first month. Watch Guardians vs. Dodgers on DIRECTV for freeWatch Guardians vs. Dodgers on FuboTV for freeWhat are the latest odds for Guardians vs. Dodgers? Best streaming options: FuboTV (free trial and $25 off your first month) and DIRECTV (free trial and $35 off your first month)Here is more information on rookie Chase DeLauter’s sensational start from cleveland.com Guardians beat writer Paul Hoynes.LOS ANGELES — Who else could have won it?Guardians outfielder Chase DeLauter, after his dramatic four-game coming-out-party against Seattle, was named American League Player of the Week on Monday for the first week of the 2026 season.DeLauter, playing in the first four regular season games of his career, hit .353 (6 for 17) with four homers and five RBI. DeLauter made his big-league debut last year when he started Games 2 and 3 of the wild card series against Detroit.He is the first Cleveland player to win the award as a rookie since Steven Kwan on Sept. 24, 2022. He is the first Cleveland player to win the award in the first week of the season since Albert Belle in 1995.In Thursday’s season opener, DeLauter homered in his first and last at-bat. He is one of five Cleveland players to homer in his first official at-bat in the regular season. He is the only Cleveland player to homer two times in his first game.DeLauter hit homers in his first three regular season games. The only other players to do that are Kyle Lewis in 2019 and Trevor Story in 2016.
